降低适用技能或物品魔法消耗的比例。: The percentage reduction to applicable mana costs.
固定消耗减少、百分比消耗和多来源叠加需分别核验。: Flat reductions, percentage costs and stacking need separate verification.
技能或物品效果覆盖的空间范围及其加成。: The spatial extent of an effect and applicable bonuses.
半径、直径、宽度和全局作用不能互换；施法距离独立计算，是否受范围加成影响由来源条: Radius, diameter, width and global effects are distinct. Cast range is separate and source conditions determine whether area bonuses apply.
增强适用治疗效果的数值。: An increase to applicable healing effects.
施加治疗与受到治疗的修正分开；不自动推广到生命恢复或吸血。: Outgoing and incoming healing modifiers are separate; do not automatically extend these rules to regeneration or lifesteal.
覆盖治疗、恢复或吸血的范围依对象说明，不能把所有恢复机制默认套用相同倍率。: Its coverage of healing, regeneration or lifesteal depends on the object description.
改变适用负面状态持续时间的修正。: A modifier to the duration of applicable debuffs.
与状态抗性、减速强度及基础持续时间分开；例外和叠加需要同版核验。: Separate from status resistance, slow strength and base duration; exceptions and stacking require version-specific verification.
英雄定义的主要属性类型，或明确作用于主属性的加成。: A hero’s primary attribute type or a bonus explicitly applied to the primary attribute.
力量、敏捷、智力和全才规则按当前版本解释；主属性类型本身不是数值加成。: Strength, agility, intelligence and universal rules depend on the version. An attribute type is not itself a numeric bonus.
物品来源定义中的基础价格。: The base price declared in the item definition.
出售价格、配方总价、折扣与购买资格另有规则；零价格不代表能够免费购买。: Sell price, recipe total, discounts and purchase eligibility are separate; a zero price does not prove free availability.
查看该对象全部已收录数值与属性: View all recorded values and attributes for this object
说明技能效果能否被驱散，以及需要的驱散强度。: Whether an ability effect can be dispelled and the required dispel strength.
这是效果的可驱散性，不表示该技能本身能够施加何种驱散。同一技能的不同效果可能有例: This describes whether an effect can be dispelled, not which dispel the ability applies. Individual effects may have exceptions. An omitted field does not mean undispellable.
定义伤害按物理、魔法或纯粹规则结算。: Whether damage uses physical, magical or pure damage rules.
伤害类型与伤害来源分开；普通攻击也可能附带其他类型的伤害。: Damage type is separate from its source. Attacks can include additional damage of other types.
声明技能与目标减益免疫的交互。: The declared interaction between an ability and the target’s debuff immunity.
来源仍沿用SpellImmunity字段名；能否选取、施加效果与造成伤害不能仅由: The source retains the SpellImmunity field name. Target selection, effect application and damage cannot be inferred from each other using this field alone.
定义技能允许作用的友方或敌方阵营。: Which friendly or enemy teams an ability can affect.
阵营过滤与目标类型、目标标记共同生效。: Team, target type and target flags are applied together.
定义技能允许作用的对象类别，可组合多个值。: The object categories an ability can affect; multiple values can be combined.
多个标记是来源组合，不按普通数值加总。: Combined flags are source declarations and are not summed as ordinary numbers.
进一步限制或放宽目标选择的来源标记。: Source flags that further restrict or allow target selection.
逐值保留原始标记；未审阅标记不猜测中文含义。: Every raw flag is preserved. Unreviewed flags are not assigned speculative meanings.
技能的施放方式及行为标记，可以同时具有多个值。: The ability’s cast method and behavior flags; multiple values may apply.
被动、目标方式、持续施法与引擎行为标记分别保留；未知标记待解释。: Passive behavior, target mode, channeling and engine flags remain separate. Unknown flags await interpretation.
单位采用近战、远程或无普通攻击的方式。: Whether a unit uses melee attacks, ranged attacks or has no normal attack.
远程分类不直接给出攻击距离、弹道速度或伤害类型。: A ranged classification does not establish attack range, projectile speed or damage type.
单位定义中的地面、飞行或无移动能力。: Whether a unit uses ground movement, flying movement or cannot move.
移动方式与飞行视野、碰撞和穿越地形的临时效果分别判断。: Movement mode is separate from flying vision, collision and temporary terrain traversal effects.
单位来源的攻击类别，用于攻击与防御类别的交互。: The source attack class used in attack/defense class interactions.
这是AttackDamageType分类，与物理、魔法、纯粹的伤害类型分开；倍率: This AttackDamageType classification is separate from physical, magical and pure damage. The multiplier matrix needs matching-version verification.
单位来源的防御类别。: The defense class declared in a unit’s source.
防御类别和护甲数值不同；与攻击类别的具体倍率不能从名称推断。: Defense class is separate from armor value. Multipliers against attack classes cannot be inferred from their names.
可组合多个枚举值；缺失字段不等于任何默认值。: Multiple values can be combined; an omitted field does not imply a default value.
取一个枚举值；缺失字段不等于任何默认值。: Takes one enum value; an omitted field does not imply a default value.
枚举属性按各取值解释行为；不进行数值相加。具体效果与例外仍以所属对象说明为准。: Enum values describe behavior and are not numerically added. The owning object’s description determines specific effects and exceptions.
普通驱散即可移除适用效果，强驱散也可移除；目标与正负效果限制仍按机制处理。: A basic dispel can remove applicable effects, as can a strong dispel. Target and buff/debuff restrictions still apply.
普通驱散无法移除，需要强驱散。: A basic dispel cannot remove this effect; a strong dispel is required.
普通与强驱散均不能移除该效果；死亡或特殊移除规则另行处理。: Neither basic nor strong dispels remove the effect; death and special removal rules are separate.
通常受护甲影响，格挡与其他修正另外结算。: Normally affected by armor; block and other modifiers are applied separately.
通常受魔法抗性影响，免疫与特殊修正规则另行处理。: Normally affected by magic resistance; immunity and special modifiers are separate.
不按护甲或魔法抗性减免，仍可能受其他伤害规则影响。: Not reduced by armor or magic resistance, but other damage rules can still apply.
来源明确声明无伤害类型，不与未提供字段混淆。: The source explicitly declares no damage type; this is distinct from an omitted field.
忽略后摇的行为标记，不是后摇时长；具体执行规则待同版核验。: A behavior flag for ignoring backswing, not a duration. Its execution rules need matching-version verification.
英雄定义的主要属性类型。: The primary attribute type declared for the hero.
取值为力量、敏捷、智力或全才；对应的攻击力换算由当前版本机制决定。: Strength, agility, intelligence or universal; damage conversion follows the selected version’s mechanics.
起始与目标为同一版本。: The start and target versions are identical.
对象和改动项按最大影响排序，相同改动项连续排列，项内按方向及影响排序；持平中的问: Entities and subjects are ranked by their largest impact. Changes to the same subject stay together, ordered by direction and impact. A question mark beside Neutral means the effect is not yet determined.
幅度为各等级数值变化率的均值，以旧值绝对值为分母；旧值为零时不计算百分比。: Magnitude is the mean numeric change across levels, divided by the absolute old value. A zero baseline has no defined percentage.
排序结合控制、冷却、经济等作用、变化尺度及天赋条件；估算优先级不代表胜率或整体强: Ranking considers control, cooldown, economy, scales and talent conditions. The estimated priority is not a win-rate or overall power estimate.
差值为终点减起点，多等级逐级计算；相同差值合并显示，百分比属性使用百分点。: Change is the ending value minus the starting value, calculated per level. Identical changes are shown once; percentage values use percentage points.

自定义半径为情景参数；所选对象有同版视野时采用其数值，监视者按激活后计算。: Custom radii are scenario inputs. Selected objects use same-version vision values when available; Watchers are treated as active.
